Encounters and Evasion

When an encounter is possible, roll 2d6 for surprise (a result of 1-2 on a d6 can mean surprise for one side) and 2d6 on the monster reaction table. Hostile creatures may attack, parley or flee according to the result; the DM adjusts for obvious strength, alignment and previous conduct.

2d6Reaction
2-3Hostile, attacks immediately
4-5Hostile, may attack
6-7Neutral, uncertain
8-9No attack, may parley
10-12Friendly, helpful or enthusiastic

Wandering monsters are rolled by time and terrain. Evasion, pursuit and hiding use movement rates, surprise and the DM's judgment.
